biur-halacha/1:_: And he does not drink wine, etc. — see Mishna Berurah what he wrote regarding strong wine from the country; and know that from the language of the Mishna and all the poskim it implies that even a small amount he may not drink. However, all this is per the reason of the Yerushalmi, because of intoxication — therefore the Sages did not permit even a drop aside from the four cups. However, for the other reason, lest it appear he is adding to the cups — if so, perhaps this applies only when he drinks the measure of a cup; and what the Rama wrote and all of it counts as one drinking means even if what remains has the measure of a revi'it — and this requires further study.
eliyah-rabbah/1:_: [1] Third cup, etc. — and one requires rinsing and washing, even for one who is not careful all year (Acharonim).
kaf-hachayyim/1:_: (1) [Seif 1] Afterwards they pour the third cup. And one requires rinsing and washing; and even one who was not careful all year — if he saw the cup is clean, nevertheless on this night he should be extra careful to beautify the mitzvah — Maharshal in responsa siman 88, Bach, Knesset HaGedolah in Hagahot Taz, Eliyah Rabbah letter 1. However the Taz s.k. 1 wrote in the name of Maharshal: even one who is not careful all year to see if the cup is clean, etc., and it implies he meant that even one not careful all year to see if it is clean, on this night he should be extra careful to look; and if it is clean he need not rinsing and washing — so too Chok Yaakov letter 1 and so too some Acharonim; and it is possible they had a different version in Maharshal; but in the Maharshal responsa in our hands it is as Bach and Knesset HaGedolah and Eliyah Rabbah wrote, that it implies even if it is clean on this night he should be extra careful and do rinsing and washing — see Eliyah Rabbah. And see above siman 483 seif 1 and in our words there letter 4 that we wrote per Zohar and Tikkunim the cup of Birkas Hamazon requires rinsing and washing even if it is clean — see Eliyah Rabbah. And also see above siman 473 letter 1 and siman 474 letter 2.
yad-ephraim/1:_: (In Magen Avraham s.k. 2) Both say Hodu — meaning; and if so it is proven from what is written in Sotah that it is because there are two besides the minor and he joins with them.
